basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old bibliophile from Bournemouth, UK. I work as a freelance editor, which lets me spend most of my days surrounded by books. Outside of work, I enjoy discussing literature and sharing insights on my favorite reads. I'm single and content, focusing on personal growth and my career. I usually browse Reddit during the late evenings, often with a cup of herbal tea by my side. My interests include reading science fiction, experimenting with new recipes, and hiking along the coastline.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in English Literature and have worked in the publishing industry for over a decade. My expertise comes from both formal education and hands-on experience in editing and critiquing manuscripts. I am also an avid reader, constantly expanding my knowledge through diverse genres.
